outcome: placental macrophage accumulation (CD68 and CD163 expression)
cohort: Placental tissues from 22 pregnancies complicated by Gestational Diabetes Mellitus (GDM) and 22 unaffected controls, matched for maternal age, gestational age at birth, and method of delivery.
finding: Gestational Diabetes Mellitus (GDM) is associated with altered placental histology, increased meconium-laden macrophages, greater placental iron stores, and higher CD163 expression on chorionic and decidual macrophage-like cells.
